text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, it is important to identify risks, which means finding anything that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you need mitigation strategies, or actions that reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans in case the main plan fails. Finally, monitoring means checking risks regularly, because new ones can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and make better decisions.
